newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BLONDEAU CONFIRMS HE WANTS TO LEAVE MONACO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLONDEAU CONFIRMS HE WANTS TO LEAVE MONACO.

text.p: Monaco defender Patrick Blondeau confirmed he wanted to leave the club after virtually winning the French first division championship on Tuesday but said he was still hesitating between an English and a Italian club.

"I was impatient to win this title because it's my first and because it will allow me to look towards Italy or England," said the 29-year-old Blondeau, effectively denying reports that he might join Marseille next season.
Blondeau did not name the clubs he was thinking of but English premier league Sheffield Wednesday, currently fighting for a place in the UEFA Cup, have reportedly made an offer for him.
Monaco virtually made sure of their first title in nine years when they beat Strasbourg 2-0 away on Tuesday to take a 12-point lead with three games remaining.

Even if Paris St Germain beat Lille on Wednesday to close the gap to nine points, they can snatch the title only by winning all their remaining matches -- with Monaco losing all theirs -- and overcoming a goal deficit of 11.
"It took us time but now it's done," said Blondeau. "We were getting tired and nervous but we eventually reached our goal. I feel we deserve to be champions."
